title: OmniReqDetailsForRCS
description: Contains properties specifying to the service how to construct the message for this channel.

template.description: The name of the template to use for this message.

parameters.description: Contains sub-properties with values for variables in the message template. Which sub-properties to include here depends on which template you have selected.

text.description:
The main text of your message.
**Required for:** `text`,`dial_action`,`url_action`,`2_suggested_replies`, `3_suggested_replies` templates.

button_text_1.description:
The text of the first suggested reply.
**Required for:** `2_suggested_replies`, `3_suggested_replies` templates.

button_payload_1.description:
Unique identifier for the first reply.
**Required for:** `2_suggested_replies`, `3_suggested_replies` templates.

button_text_2.description:
The text of the second suggested reply.
**Required for:** `2_suggested_replies`, `3_suggested_replies` templates.

button_payload_2.description:
Unique identifier for the second reply.
**Required for:** `2_suggested_replies`, `3_suggested_replies` templates.

button_text_3.description:
The text of the third suggested reply.
**Required for:** `3_suggested_replies` template.

button_payload_3.description:
Unique identifier for the third reply.
**Required for:** `3_suggested_replies` template.

url_text.description:
Text for the link in the message.
**Required for:** `url_action`, `rc_url_action_vertical`, `rc_url_action_horizontal` templates.

url_payload.description:
Unique identifier for the link in the message.
**Required for:** `url_action`, `rc_url_action_vertical`, `rc_url_action_horizontal` templates.

url.description:
Depending on the template being used, this is either the URL for the link in the message or the URL for a media file or file attachment to embed in the message.
**Required for:** `media`, `url_action`, `rc_url_action_vertical`, `rc_url_action_horizontal`, `file`

dial_text.description:
Text on the click-to-call button.
**Required for:** `dial_action`, `rc_dial_action_vertical`, `rc_dial_action_horizontal` templates.

phone_number_to_dial.description:
The complete phone number to call when the button is selected. Include `+` at the beginning of international numbers.
**Required for:** `dial_action`, `rc_dial_action_vertical`, `rc_dial_action_horizontal` templates.

dial_payload.description:
Unique identifier for the click-to-call phone number in the message.
**Required for:** `dial_action`, `rc_dial_action_vertical`, `rc_dial_action_horizontal` templates.

media_url.description:
The URL reference for the image to include in the rich card in your message.
**Required for:** `rc_url_action_vertical`, `rc_dial_action_vertical`, `rc_url_action_horizontal`, `rc_dial_action_horizontal` templates.

latitude.description:
The latitude coordinate of your location as a positive or negative number.
**Required for:** `location`

longitude.description:
The longitude coordinate of your location as a positive or negative number.
**Required for:** `location`
